cards.title: Introduction to RxJS
cards.content:
RxJS Basics

RxJS (Reactive Extensions for JavaScript) is a library for reactive programming using Observables. Angular uses it heavily for async operations like HTTP requests and routing.

  • Observable: A stream of data over time.
  • Observer: An object that listens to an Observable (next, error, complete).
  • Subscription: Represents the execution of an Observable. Used to cancel the execution (unsubscribe).

cards.title: Pipes and Operators
cards.content:
Operators

Operators are pure functions that enable complex async code to be composed easily. You use the pipe() method to chain operators.

  • map: Transforms data.
  • filter: Filters data.
  • switchMap: Cancels previous requests and switches to a new inner Observable.
  • catchError: Catches errors on the observable.
  • tap: Performs side effects without modifying the stream.

cards.title: Subjects
cards.content:
Subjects and BehaviorSubjects

A Subject is a special type of Observable that allows values to be multicasted to many Observers. It is both an Observable and an Observer.

A BehaviorSubject is a variant of Subject that requires an initial value and emits its current value whenever it is subscribed to.

options.text: Subject emits an initial value, BehaviorSubject does not.
BehaviorSubject requires an initial value and emits the latest value to new subscribers.
Subject is used for HTTP requests, BehaviorSubject is for routing.
